card.name: Slot after theory or doctrine
card.fires_on: The word 'of' right after 'theory', 'doctrine' or similar in philosophy, religion and science-history text. It also fires on verbs like 'taught' or 'arguing for' where a doctrine is about to be named.

modes.label: Of after theory/doctrine
modes.description: The word 'of' follows 'theory' or 'doctrine' before the name of the idea.
modes.example: Darwin's Darkest Hour A two-hour drama on the crisis that forced Darwin to publish his theory<< of>> evolution.

modes.label: Verbs introducing a view
modes.description: A verb or preposition that introduces a philosophical or scientific position being held or argued.
modes.example: Albert, who was a contemporary of David, says that David merely renewed the heresy of Alexander, "who<< taught>> that God and intellect and matter are one
